messages:
maya.cs: Quick ask — can someone assemble a single-page "Edge Priming" cheat sheet for customers (one-pager they can forward to SREs). Needs: 4 bite-size actions, 2 troubleshooting lines, 1 short cost note, and a tiny curl example for engineers. Prefer plain language.

sam.se: I got this. I'll make bullets for three patterns: interactive UI, background batch workers, and ramp/onboarding bursts. Will include one-line tech appendix.

anita_csm: Important: include a renewal trigger — if active sessions are <60% of forecast after 48h, tag renewals and book a health check. Also add a short line: "Prefills consume tokens immediately; keep warm pools conservative."

jorge.eng: Adding a small prefill snippet for SREs to paste: 

jorge.eng: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: tenant-99" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-instruct-small","prefill_tokens":1200,"ttl":300,"strategy":"kv-prefix"}'
```

jorge.eng: Engineering appendix suggestions (one line each): batching_window_ms=30, max_batch_size=24, cache_ttl_s=300, enable_kv_cache=true, streaming_chunk_ms=40. Note: lower batch window to 10-15ms for single-digit latency widgets.

ellie.pm: Customer-facing TL;DR bullets (very short):
- "Edge Priming: 4 quick actions to cut cold latency"
- "1) Prefill a small warm pool (5–10 samples) ~5 minutes before traffic peak; TTL ~5m."
- "2) Batch background jobs (window ~20–50ms, max size 16–32) to save cost."
- "3) Use short per-tenant cache TTLs for personalized content; longer TTLs for shared prompts."
- "4) Turn on streaming for interactive flows (chunk latency ~30–60ms)."
- "Cost note: Prefills use tokens up front; monitor usage and scale warm pools gradually."

sam.se: Two quick troubleshooting lines for the customer (copyable):
- "If request rate drops after go-live, check client retries, auth errors, and token quotas."
- "If 95th percentile latency spikes >200ms for >5% of requests, open a support ticket and attach a sample request ID."

maya.cs: Love it. Also add a single checkbox line for CS reps: "If 48h activation <60% of expected, tag @renewals and schedule a re-onboard."

ops-bot: Reminder: run `/reserve-warm-pool tenant-99 10` before demos. Automation reduces ops load.

sam.se: I'll format this into a one-page and put in the onboarding doc library, shareable view for customers, with the curl block in the appendix.

maya.cs: Perfect — I'll paste into the Welcome email template and ping the onboarding squad before sending. :rocket:
